title: Renox route table, artifact contract version 0
description: The gateway's hostname -> tenant -> deployment table (F1: a local JSON file). Prose: docs/contracts/artifact.md section 5. At most one active entry per hostname and unique (hostname, deployment_hash) are checked by V13.

hostname.description: Lower-case ASCII (IDNA A-labels), no port, no trailing dot.

status.description: active: receives new requests. draining: finishes in-flight requests, then evicted. suspended (artifact 1.5, deploy-api 0.5.1): the tenant is suspended; the gateway answers the neutral suspension page and no cell is touched.

display_name.description: artifact 1.5: the tenant's name, shown on the neutral suspension page; only on suspended entries.
